title: Tell the owner about each bank transfer received
summary: When Moniepoint (Monnify) reports money received into your account, text the owner and log it in a sheet.
description: Whenever Moniepoint (Monnify) reports a successful payment into your reserved account, texts the owner who paid and how much, and adds a row to your collections sheet at the same time. The owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Collections spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link.

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Sheet
params.description: The sheet and columns rows are added to.

params.name: moniepoint_connection
params.title: Moniepoint connection
params.description: The Moniepoint (Monnify) connection whose webhooks start this workflow.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

definition.name: Tell the owner about transfers received

steps.name: Tell the owner and log it
Add it to the collections sheet
